newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Chubais meets Paris Club head.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Chubais meets Paris Club head.

text.p: Russian First Deputy Prime Minister Anatoly Chubais on Friday met the chairman of the Paris Club to discuss Russia's membership in the group of creditor nations, his office said in a statement.
Chubais, recently appointed to spearhead Russian economic reforms, discussed with Christian Noyer issues related to what role Russia would play in the Paris Club, the statement said.

"Chubais and Noyer agreed that during the preparations for the June Denver meeting of leading industrialised countries, including Russia, the main parameters of Russian participation in the Club's activities will be defined," it said.
Russia is seeking to promote its membership in a series of international economic organisations including the World Trade Organisation, the Group of Seven and the Paris Club of creditor nations.
It is hoping that membership in the Paris Club as a creditor would make it easier to recover loans extended by the Soviet Union to a series of Third World countries.
Countries owing Russia $37 billion already have agreements with the Paris Club, and Russia hopes to receive the same deal as other creditor countries.
